events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis — Iran Military Reshuffle, Talks Stalling, Oil Rising
events.summary: Iran shakes up military leadership — IRGC hardliner Rezaei appointed, signaling escalation faction in control. Strait of Hormuz talks stalling. Trump shifts to 'low-key' pressure strategy, no rush to resolve. Oil prices rising as Iran tempers optimism about Hormuz reopening. Brent ~$85/bbl. 22 EU heads of government letter criticizes Spain's regularization as 'pull factor' for Ceuta crisis. Largest energy disruption in recorded history ongoing. Houthis attacking Saudi oil tankers. Iran parliament reviewing ban on US/Israeli ships.
events.update_from_previous: Military leadership reshuffle (Rezaei/IRGC hardliner), talks stalling, oil rising again after temporary optimism. EU diplomatic tensions escalating over Ceuta spillover.

events.title: US-Japan Joint Currency Intervention Unraveling — Yen Erases Half of Gains
events.summary: Historic US-Japan joint currency intervention is unraveling — yen has erased half the gains. JPY at 159.29/dollar, worst session since February. Yen swung to 1% loss despite US/Japan authorities' efforts. BOJ expected to hike to 1.25% in September. Fed held rates at 3.50-3.75% with 30% market probability of hike. BlackRock notes scarcity-driven inflation from Middle East energy shock has driven repricing of Fed expectations from easing to tightening, global rise in bond yields. Questions over efficacy of intervention — more currency moves may be needed.
events.update_from_previous: SEVERITY UPGRADED 4→5. Intervention unraveling, yen erasing gains. BlackRock confirms scarcity-driven inflation shifting Fed expectations to tightening. Global bond yields rising.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — 4,230 Cases, 1,918 Deaths, Outpacing Global Response
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC and Uganda. WHO PHEIC declared May 16, 2026. As of Aug 7: 4,230 confirmed cases, 1,918 deaths (45.3% fatality rate). Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, second largest ever. WHO and Africa CDC conceded Aug 6 that outbreak is outpacing response. Imported case in France. Ongoing armed conflict (M23) hinders detection/treatment. True scale likely exceeds confirmed numbers. Existing treatments certified for Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo — complicating response.
events.update_from_previous: Cases up from ~4,141 to 4,230 (+89). Deaths up from 1,889 to 1,918 (+29). France imported case confirmed. 45.3% fatality rate. WHO concedes response outpaced.

developments_not_cat5.note: Colombia new rightwing president (De La Espriella), $1B US security aid pledged. Rightward shift across Latin America. Not category-5.
Ceuta border crisis — Italy suspended Schengen with Spain, Spain retaliated with border checks. 22 EU heads criticized Spain's regularization policy. Diplomatic stress but not macro-5.
China Shock 2.0 reshuffling markets (Reuters Aug 9). PBOC net draining yuan in OMO. Digital yuan 5-year plan published. No new emergency.
Emerging Asia currency defense getting makeover (Bloomberg Aug 9). Central banks finding non-reserve tools. Not at crisis level.
EIA: oil prices falling on expected supply increase. Brent forecast $74/bbl for 3Q26. Moderating factor amid Hormuz crisis.
No acute bank failure. BlackRock notes hyperscaler capex revised 30% higher to $720B for 2026. BofA bullishness highest since 2021. No systemic risk event.
Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapeño peppers (CDC Aug 10). Not macro-level.

notes: 3 active cat-5 events confirmed. Iran-Hormuz crisis escalating with IRGC hardliner appointment. US-Japan intervention unraveling — severity upgraded to 5. Ebola continues worsening (+89 cases, +29 deaths since last scan). Global bond yields rising on scarcity-driven inflation. BlackRock confirms Fed repricing from easing to tightening. Oil moderating on supply expectations but Hormuz risk dominates.
